register.labelZh: SLOG 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: slog away 表示某人持續努力工作,尤其適合描述需要很長時間完成的任務。；slog it out 可以描述球隊、候選人或其他對手苦戰到底,直至其中一方勝出。；當一本書、一份表格、一份報告或大量訊息需要花很大力氣才能完成時,可以使用 slog through。；這些 SLOG 表達常見於談論工作、學習、競爭和令人疲累的任務。
register.summaryEn: Slog away shows that somebody continues working very hard, especially when the task takes a long time. Slog it out can describe teams, candidates or other sides competing hard until one of them succeeds. Slog through is useful when a book, form, report or pile of messages takes a great deal of effort to finish. These SLOG expressions are useful in conversations about work, study, competitions and tiring tasks.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；slog away 本身已是完整表達。你可以加上 at something,說明正在努力處理甚麼:He slogged away.He slogged away at the report.；在 slog it out 中,it 是固定表達的一部分。with、over 和 for 等字詞只用來補充資料:The teams slogged it out.The teams slogged it out for the title.
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Slog away is complete by itself. At something can be added to identify the task: He slogged away. He slogged away at the report. In slog it out, it is part of the fixed expression. Words such as with, over and for only add information: The teams slogged it out. The teams slogged it out for the title.
